answer: Weight needs one professional engineer licence: a degree, the FE exam, four supervised years, the PE exam; the registry publishes one verification signal per licence, and a second claim is rejected. Each fake costs one real engineer: 1,460 supervised days and 2,200 units in fees; 100 fakes cost 220,000 units and 400 engineer-years; the fable of a bought degree dies at the transcript check. Cheapest cheat: hire a licensed engineer to lend their stamp — the lender surrenders the seal backing their own identity; a forged licence on velvet stock fails the registry check and voids the cluster.
